documentation.content: A limit on tuckerpaymentprocessing.com started biting. The log line says which one (kind=...): fair_share, busy_mode, nap, month_50, month_80, zip_lockout, cipher_gap (Cipher got past a defense: fix it) or test. Each kind is sent at most once a day. Limits are set in /etc/tucker/tucker.env (see app/config.py); restart the app after changing them.
